_note: SANITIZED REAL PRODUCTION PANEL #2 (a second 360.001 Ventilasjon exported with the userscript): 92 objects, 39 distinct obj_ids, 55 of them linked, on the same 00-blank-sidebar background as real-vent-panel-example.json - the SECOND normative style reference for AI-generated ventilation panels. Same doctrine, different plant and AHU: BACNET drivers instead of OJEXHAUST, horizontal dampers (V3_horis_damper_flow-left/right_nrm), a dummy 2-way motor, a green/grey status LED, the sub-page navigation row (sub_page_link_btn_home/left/right + sub_page_80_24_kurver_btn) and a file_pdf document link whose driver_id and file_pdf both hold /iw_plants/iw_NNNNN/files/<name>.pdf. Instrument-code tag_texts follow the same house style (LI/SB/RT/RD/RF/JV + number). Plant id, site token and saved_by masked; generic blank background kept so the file renders 1:1 on insert. Objects only - there is no image_svg, and the image_svg_trace is just the blank background.
